import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
import warnings
import os

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Target classes: {train_df['Cover_Type'].nunique()}")
print(
    f"Target distribution:\n{train_df['Cover_Type'].value_counts().sort_values(ascending=False)}"
)

# Prepare features
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["Id", "Cover_Type"]]
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].values
y_train = train_df["Cover_Type"].values.astype(int)
X_test = test_df[feature_cols].values
test_id = test_df["Id"].values

# FIX: Convert 1-indexed labels to 0-indexed for LightGBM
y_train_encoded = y_train - 1

# Create hold-out validation split from training data (non-stratified to handle rare classes)
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train_encoded, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)
print(f"\nValidation set created: {len(X_val)} samples")
print(
    f"Validation target distribution:\n{pd.Series(y_val + 1).value_counts().sort_values(ascending=False)}"
)

# LightGBM parameters - OPTIMIZED for speed
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "num_class": 7,
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": 8,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "max_bin": 50,
    "num_threads": 8,
}

# Create LightGBM datasets with 0-indexed labels
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_full, label=y_train_full)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train model with reduced iterations for faster training
print("\nTraining LightGBM model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=200,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    valid_names=["train", "valid"],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=30, verbose=False)],
)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
print("\nEvaluating on hold-out validation set...")
val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_pred = np.argmax(val_pred, axis=1)
# FIX: Convert 0-indexed predictions back to 1-indexed for metric calculation
val_pred_1idx = val_pred + 1
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val + 1, val_pred_1idx)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Make predictions on test set
print("\nMaking predictions on test set...")
test_pred = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
test_pred = np.argmax(test_pred, axis=1)
# FIX: Convert 0-indexed predictions to 1-indexed for submission
test_pred_1idx = test_pred + 1

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_id, "Cover_Type": test_pred_1idx})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")

# Verify submission format
print(f"\nSubmission sample:\n{submission.head()}")

# Print final validation metric
print(f"\n{'='*50}")
print(f"HOLD-OUT VALIDATION ACCURACY: {val_accuracy:.6f}")
print(f"{'='*50}")
